input.contract_name: Custodial and Grounds Maintenance Services – Shenandoah Valley Federal Buildings (GSA PBS Mid-Atlantic Region 3PQ)
input.notes: Conformed through Amendment 0001 (Sept 18, 2026). Base period Mar 1, 2027 – Feb 29, 2028 plus four 12-month option periods (5 years); FAR 52.217-8 extension up to 6 months evaluated separately. FFP with Above Standard Services (CLIN 0003, $75,000 NTE). Five buildings in scope after A0001 deleted VA0355ZZ. Mowing weekly April 1 – October 31 (approx. 30 cuts per season) per C.4.2. Wage determinations 2015-4311 (Winchester/Frederick Co.) and 2015-4327 (Harrisonburg/Rockingham/Staunton/Augusta).

input.notes: Q3/A3: base year + four option years, 60 months, March 1, 2022 – February 28, 2027. Annual value = current Option Year 4 value $1,146,880. Covers the six buildings as originally issued including VA0355ZZ (235,370 custodial SF in total) and grounds at VA0123ZZ, VA0187ZZ, VA0318ZZ, VA0355ZZ and VA0402ZZ; does not include VA0241ZZ Suite 210. New scope after A0001 is 219,850 custodial SF (VA0355ZZ deleted, Suite 210 added). Contract type of the incumbent contract not stated. Spend to date not stated. Provided for reference only.

input.summary: GSA PBS solicitation 47PC0326R0014 (conformed through Amendment 0001), custodial and grounds maintenance at the Shenandoah Valley Federal Buildings (Winchester, Harrisonburg, Staunton VA); 1-year base + 4 option years. Registered all 6 Exhibit J.1 building information sheets: 5 in scope (VA0123ZZ, VA0187ZZ, VA0241ZZ, VA0318ZZ, VA0402ZZ; 287,070 GSF, 219,850 custodial SF, which matches the Section B CLIN 0001 total) and VA0355ZZ Federal Records Annex deleted by Amendment 0001 (22,480 GSF / 16,920 custodial SF, reference only). VA0241ZZ carries the A0001 revision to 22,860 custodial SF (Suite 210). Grounds: 18 Section F rows (landscaped/improved turf, parking, sidewalks) for the 4 grounds buildings in scope; VA0241ZZ grounds excluded (USPS) and VA0355ZZ grounds deleted; plus 2 out-of-scope remark areas (VA0187ZZ child care playground, VA0402ZZ wooded buffer). Incumbent: Caldera Ridge Facility Services, LLC, 47PC0322C0042, $5,612,350 over 60 months, current option year $1,146,880.
unresolved: Page numbers: the text has no page markers; source.page uses the sequential page order of the excerpt (1 = Summary of Changes, 2 = B-2, 3-5 = C-1 to C-3, 6-11 = Exhibit J.1 sheets J.1-1 to J.1-6).

Total Site Area per building (3.10, 4.60, 0.82, 2.40, 8.75, 1.90 acres) is information only and includes building footprints, wooded buffers and areas maintained by others; not registered as a grounds area.
VA0402ZZ: mixed frequency (11,800 SF daily, 28,870 SF warehouse/shops/dock/stairs weekly); registered as daily_5 with the split in notes.

Snow and ice removal (entrances, steps, ramps, walks) applies at all in-scope buildings (federal entrance only at VA0241ZZ); parking lot plowing, day-porter restroom checks at VA0318ZZ and extra window washing are Above Standard Services under CLIN 0003 ($75,000 NTE) and not in the FFP inventory.
Window washing glass areas (one side) are recorded in facility notes only; there is no tool field for them.
